description: This file defines the OrangeHrmClient class, a minimal HTTP client wrapper for interacting with the OrangeHRM API in automation tests. It provides methods for cookie-based login, executing authenticated and anonymous requests, and utility functions for URL building and JSON parsing.

classes.name: OrangeHrmClient
classes.description: A minimal HTTP client for automating interactions with the OrangeHRM API, supporting login, authenticated requests, and JSON handling.

methods.name: LoginWithCookiesAsync
methods.description: Attempts to log in using cookies via the web auth endpoint, handling redirects and error cases.

methods.name: ExecuteAuthedAsync
methods.description: Executes an API request with support for bearer token or session cookies, expecting a JSON response.

methods.name: ExecuteAnonAsync
methods.description: Executes an anonymous API request, indicating no authentication is needed.

methods.name: V2
methods.description: Constructs a full API v2 URL path from a resource path, ensuring proper formatting.

methods.name: ParseJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonDocument for flexible assertions during testing.
